notes.title: Patch Note V.0.5.1 - Duriano
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! Following the release of Patch 0.5.1, we noticed some issues with the new Morning Star weapon. We've taken action and given a small buff to its augments in this patch, along with various bug fixes.
[p align="start"]Additionally, we've updated the UI and added Japanese language support to celebrate Duriano's participation in the Tokyo Game Show 2025 in Japan.


Feature Update
QoL for permanent upgrade

Permanent Upgrades will now show all upcoming upgrade tiers you have not yet unlocked. These will be marked with a symbol to let you know how many more tiers are waiting
General Gameplay Update
Rework Blacksmith system

Now the Blacksmith chamber will no longer give players a free augment. Instead, it is now a shop that sells augments at a random discount

Change augment’s rarity chance

Changed the random chance for all augments to appear in the shop
Balance Update
Buff Morning Star’s augment

Grasp of Warrior’s special effect damage from 50 + 50% Physical Damage > 50 + 100% Physical Damage

Core of Destruction’s token duration increases from 5 seconds > 15 seconds and token damage from 50 + 100% of Physical Damage > 50 + 200% of Physical Damage

God’s skill rework

Forseti’s skill

God’s skill level 1: Gain Shield equal 100% of Max HP, +200 Thorn for 6 seconds and after 3 seconds, explode 90% of Shield that player have and deal damage equal 200% of player's current Shield to all enemies

God’s skill level 2: Gain Shield equal 150% of Max HP, +500 Thorn for 6 seconds and after 3 seconds, explode 90% of Shield that player have and deal damage equal 200% of player's current Shield to all enemies

God’s skill level 3: Gain Shield equal 200% of Max HP, +1000 Thorn for 6 seconds and after 3 seconds, explode 90% of Shield that player have and deal damage equal 500% of player's current Shield to all enemies

Mimir’s skill

God’s skill level 1: +20 Spell Damage for 5 seconds and deal damage 50 + 50% Spell Damage + 50% Trail Pray to all enemies and inflict Burn for 7 seconds

Aegir’s skill

God’s skill level 3: +25 Life Steal and +35 Evasion for 5 seconds. Summon 3 Spirit of the dept for 7 seconds that will attack projectile to the nearest enemy for every 0.2 seconds and global range, deal damage 50 + 500% Life Steal. After 7 seconds, the Big Spirit of the dept will detonate to deal damage 1000 + 10000% Life Steal
Menu & UI Update
Update Japanese Localization

New UI for result scene

New main menu UI
Bug Fixes
Fixed bug where player fall out of map

Fixed bug where the animation background not working when switch screen

Fixed bug where player’s HP doesn't equal 0 when player die

Fixed bug where player can’t lock item in shop

Fixed a bug where the name text for the Xbox joystick displayed incorrectly

notes.title: Patch Note V.0.5.0 - Duriano
notes.content:
We’ve carefully listened to every comment and suggestion, and this patch overhauls the core experience: revamped systems based on player feedback, tighter balance for fair but challenging combat, and most importantly, brand-new content that will shake up your battles.

Get ready for a Viking-style hero, ruthless new weapons, and deadly enemy monsters!
 Every change is built to deliver more fun than ever. Gear up, and dive into the full details!
General Update
General Gameplay Updates

The "Take 1 Damage for every 1 second" mechanic will no longer break the Damage Nullifier status.

Adjusted the Blacksmith's item lock system. Locked items can now be set to be free (0 coins).

Adjusted the auto-collect system. Healing Herbs will now be automatically collected at the end of a chamber, even if the player has full health.

Adjusted the item drop system. Any items that fall off the map will now be automatically returned to the playable area.

The next possible chamber type will now be displayed in the bottom-left corner of the Shop, Level-up, Fate's Flavor, Blacksmith, and Prophet UIs. If there are duplicate chamber types, only one icon will be shown.

Added new information to the Duriano Codex.

Reworked Knockback Mechanic and Scaling

War Hammer & Morning Star: Base knockback changed from 5→2.

All Augments: Base knockback has been changed to 0.

Bear Headdress: Knockback changed from −3→−1.

Lucky Flower of Eir: Knockback changed from 5→2.

+10 Attack Speed

+2 Armor

+5 Life Steal

When killing an enemy, there is a 25% chance to Heal 1 HP.

For every 1 Dash effect from any source, gain +10 Bonus Physical Damage.

For every 3 Dash effects from any source, gain +1 Bonus Dash Charge.

Dash Cooldown modifications: +50%

Physical Damage modifications: +25%

Spell Damage modifications: −75%

Evasion modifications: −50%

Forseti Follower

+5 Max HP

+5 HP Regeneration

+5 Armor

−10 Attack Speed

−10 Movement Speed

When attacked, there is a 10% chance to gain a Shield equal to 20% of Max HP (Cooldown: 5 seconds).

Armor modification: +25%

Thorn modification: +25%

Physical Damage modification: −50%

Spell Damage modification: −50%

Life Steal modification: −50%

New Weapon & Augment

New Weapon: Morning Star

Grants +2 Weapon Damage for every player level.

Grants +3 Physical Damage for every player level.

Every 3rd attack sprays enemies with 12 Spikes of Blood in a 7-unit radius.

Each Spike of Blood deals damage equal to 75% of your Physical Damage and inflicts Bleed for 5 seconds.

Comes with 7 new unique Augments!

New God & Fate’s Flavor

New God: Njord and his Fate's Flavors

God’s Skill Level 1: Summons 2 small Golden Dolphins that spin around you, dealing damage equal to 200+200% of your current Norse Coin total for 10 seconds.

God’s Skill Level 2: Summons 2 medium Golden Dolphins that spin around you, dealing damage equal to 300+300% of your current Norse Coin total for 10 seconds.

God’s Skill Level 3: Summons 3 big Golden Dolphins that spin around you, dealing damage equal to 400+350% of your current Norse Coin total for 10 seconds.

New Enemies

Bjornflame

Tanngrisnirpep

New Status Effect

Fear

The affected enemy will run away from the player and have its Armor reduced by 5 for the duration.

New Achievements

Win run with Character: Ragnar Bloodhrafn

Win run with Character: Forseti Follower

Win run using Weapon: Morning Star



Balance Update
Nerfs

God’s Trails: Forseti

The skill at level 2 & 3 will now consume more of the shield for its explosion, increased from 70% to 90%.

Item: Dull Durian

Removed 2 attack speed and 5 Luck stats.
Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where the Pause page showed the Fate’s Flavor icon abnormally.

Fixed a bug where the UI would appear before all data had loaded.

Fixed a bug with the sound effect of the 'Hold To Reset' button.

Fixed a layering bug where some monster skills appeared under the lava map terrain.

Fixed a bug where a stat's name would display underneath another stat.

Fixed a bug where minibosses would not disappear after their timer expired.

Fixed a bug where Fate’s Flavor was interacting incorrectly with God skills.

Fixed a bug with the randomization of augments in the Prophet chamber.

Fixed a bug with the EXP amount when continuing from the 1st floor.

Fixed a bug where the player's stats would decrease if they died with a buff active and were then revived.

Fixed a bug where the UI would disappear when pausing the game.

Fixed a bug where the pause menu would disappear or fail to show info when the pause action was spammed.

Fixed a bug causing the augment info pop-up on the "Item Found" screen to display abnormally.

Fixed a bug and removed the feature that saved the player's HP at the start of a chamber.

Fixed a bug with item Heimdall's Horn(Gjallarhorn)'s bonus stats after reviving.

Fixed a bug where the description for negative stats displayed an incorrect value.

Fixed a bug where no sound would play in the Blacksmith upon a successful or failed purchase.

And that's everything in the V.0.5.0 update that we're proud to present! We hope the new characters, monsters, powerful weapon, and various improvements bring fresh fun and new challenges to everyone.

A huge thank you to all our players for being a vital part of the game's development with your invaluable feedback. We are committed to continuing the development of Duriano. Be sure to jump in, try out the new content, and let us know what you think! See you in the FULL access!

notes.title: Duriano Patch 0.4.0: A New Challenge Awaits!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102131/15072b11ec54f3903dd902268308a7b234759f2c.png"]

The Duriano development team is incredibly excited to announce a significant update: Patch 0.4.0, which is now ready to elevate your gaming experience to new heights of intensity and challenge. This update focuses on game balance adjustments, the introduction of new difficulty levels, and various content improvements to ensure Duriano remains an unforgettable adventure.

We have consistently gathered valuable feedback and suggestions from our players, using them to continuously refine and improve the game. Patch 0.4.0 is the result of that unwavering commitment. We are confident that these changes will bring about thrilling new challenges and well-deserved rewards for those who earn them.

Key Updates in Patch 0.4.0

General Gameplay Update

Boss's Mechanics Rework: Surtr, The First Giant
Surtr will no longer be a pushover! After being a punching bag for too long, we decided to make him a true boss. Surtr now has 13 new moves, spread across different difficulty levels. As the difficulty goes up, Surtr's moves become even more dangerous. Watch out, because this fire giant is getting serious!

Miniboss Damage Reduced
We decided to slightly lower miniboss damage. This is because the new, harder difficulties greatly increase monster damage, and we don't want players to be overwhelmed by our minibosses.

Contest Chamber Now Gives a Little Bit EXP
We decided to give contest chambers a small amount of EXP. This is because EXP is very important for players to survive the tough monsters right now, especially with the new, harder difficulty levels added in the update.

Removed Slow Motion when Using God's Trails or Succeeding Dodge Boss's Skill by Dash
We tried to make the game more exciting, but the slow-motion effect for God's Trails and successful boss dodges made gameplay feel less smooth. So, we've decided to remove this slow-motion feature.

New Permanent Stat Added: Thorn (Tier 4)
Unlocked when all Tier 3 permanent stats reach max level. Prepare for unparalleled defensive power!

Feature Update

New Difficulty Mode: Duriano
Test the fury of Duriano! Face a new difficulty mode that will push your limits. Battle through harsh environments and unbelievably strong enemies. Prove you are a true warrior who can conquer the Duriano!

New achievement: Welcome to Valhalla

Unlock when win the Duriano difficulty for the first time, a special achievement awaits: Welcome to Valhalla. This is a symbol of honor, demonstrating your exceptional abilities.

Balance Update

Buffed Jötunnshard and its Augments
This weapon was still weak in the last update, so we will buff it a little.

Jötunnshard

Now +1 Split Shot

Now +1 Split Shot for every 10 player's levels

This weapon's Split Shot will now deal 100% damage and can receive attack effects.

Frozen Tear

Removed +1 Split Shot

Ice bullet damage scaling changed from 50% Spell Damage > 100% Spell Damage

Augment's Crit Damage changed from 0 > 5

Shard of Avalanche

Frozen wind damage scaling changed from 100% Spell Damage > 150% Spell Damage

Ice of Eternity

Trail Pray damage amplification changed from 25% > 50%

Absolute Zero Seal

Frozen burst damage scaling changed from 150% Spell Damage > 200% Spell Damage

Augment's Crit Damage changed from 0 > 5

Frostbite's Emblem

Freeze damage changed from 5% of an enemy's maximum health > 10% of an enemy's maximum health (except bosses and minibosses)

Trail Pray damage amplification changed from 25% > 50%

Wrath of Winter

Augment's Crit Damage changed from 5 > 25

Fimbul Winter

Augment's Crit Damage changed from 5 > 25

Art & VFX Update

New textures for Cherry, SpicyDog, Ember Pear, Melon, and Hot Of Tamer.

New death animation for bosses and minibosses.

Music & SFX Update

New SFX for every Surtr move.

Bug fixes

Fixed bug enemies amount text

Fixed Vidar's Destruction damage bug

Fixed bug EXP drop rate in horde chamber

Fixed bug where Loki's Deceptive Runes (War Hammer’s augment) doesn't have description

Fixed bug where player enter black room after press restart

Fixed bug where Rune of the Alfheim reduce HP from Max HP instead of current HP

Fixed bug where player pick up coin and xp get into yourself ,Coin and xp Stuck on the map and can't collect it.

Fixed bug where coin and exp from coin / exp bag didn't disappear

Fixed bug where HP Regeneration doesn't work



The Duriano team sincerely hopes that Patch 0.4.0 will provide all of you with an even more enjoyable and challenging gaming experience. We are committed to continuously improving Duriano in the future and extend our gratitude for your continued support and loyalty.

Prepare yourselves for the new battles, and conquer the Duriano difficulty!

Good luck on your adventures.

notes.title: Duriano Update 0.3.2: A New Dimension of Combat and Adventure!
notes.content:
Brave gamers, prepare yourselves for an exhilarating new adventure in the world of Duriano! Patch 0.3.2 is here, poised to elevate your gaming experience to unprecedented heights. This isn't just a minor rebalance or a typical bug fix;  this patch represents a monumental transformation that will leave you in awe!


Gameplay Update: Conquer Bosses for Ultimate Power-Ups!
The most thrilling enhancement in this update is the improved Mini-Boss item drop system! From now on, every Mini-Boss is guaranteed to drop a Tier 4 item chest upon defeat! This significantly increases your opportunities to acquire rare and potent items, bolstering your character's strength. Get ready for Mini-Boss hunts that are more intense and rewarding than ever before!


Balance Adjustments: Familiar Heroes, Newfound Strength!
Naturally, balance adjustments are at the core of every update, and Patch 0.3.2 delivers without disappointment!

The Ice Phoenix Sorcerer has received a significant buff! Previously, this character faced considerable limitations with high Life Steal and EXP Gain Rate penalties. Now, both values have been reduced to just -25, granting the Ice Phoenix Sorcerer remarkably improved survivability and leveling efficiency! It's time for the ice mage to rise to prominence once again!


Jötunnshard's Augment is now even more powerful!
Frozen Tear: Has been upgraded to include +1 Split Shot, increasing its potential for area-of-effect damage and making group attacks significantly more effective.

Wrath of Winter: The Frost Token requirement has been reduced from 4 to 3, allowing you to utilize Wrath of Winter more frequently and inflict continuous ice damage.
Augment Improvements for Bows and Arrows:
Frigg's Aurora Quiver:  Has undergone a major effect change! Previously, the buff from Blessing of Mother's Land reduced enemy speed. Now, it provides +5000 Thorn and +15 Armor! This alteration empowers bow users to better withstand enemy attacks and introduces new strategic combat approaches!


New Feature Update: Pause Game, Anytime!
Tired of being interrupted in the heat of battle? Fret no more! Duriano Patch 0.3.2 introduces a new Pause System that allows you to halt the game at any moment, providing enhanced flexibility during your gameplay sessions!


Art & VFX Update: Aesthetic Harmony!
Beyond gameplay refinements, Duriano places a significant emphasis on visual beauty and effects!

The Ice Phoenix Sorcerer has received a new texture! Prepare to be captivated by the stunning new appearance and sharper details of the Ice Phoenix Sorcerer, making you fall in love with this character's elegance.

The icon and name of Arrow Darts of Hodr have been changed! They will now be known as Edge of Fortune, accompanied by a new, more aggressive and formidable icon!


Bug Fixes: A Seamless, Flawless Experience!
The Duriano team has diligently worked to resolve various issues previously encountered by players, aiming to deliver the most seamless gaming experience possible!

Fixed an issue causing a black screen when players set the resolution to 3420x1930.

Fixed the cut-in for the Aegir god's skill.

Fixed Healing Herb not being collected when HP is full.

Fixed an issue preventing players from continuing the game when possessing Eir's Undaunted Shield and Eir's Life Force Aura.

Duriano Patch 0.3.2 is a pivotal update that will introduce a fresh, challenging, and more exciting gaming experience than ever before! Whether you are a veteran player or new to the world of Duriano, it's time to step into this realm and immerse yourself in the grandeur of this update! Prepare for endless adventure!

Are you ready to delve into the transformed world of Duriano and experience power beyond what you've ever known?

notes.title: Weapon Focus – Yggdrasill Staff
notes.content:
In Duriano, weapons aren't just tools, they're the centerpiece of your build, shaping how you fight, what augments you seek, and which God’s Trail you align with. Today, we spotlight one of the most powerful and visually striking spell weapons in the game: the Yggdrasill Staff.

Whether you're vaporizing entire waves or watching enemies melt from chain explosions, this staff delivers destructive elegance with every cast.

What Is the Yggdrasill Staff?
Forged from the arcane roots of the World Tree, the Yggdrasill Staff channels raw elemental energy through focused bursts. Unlike other weapons, this one doesn't rely on rapid strikes or precision; its true strength lies in spell amplification and area-of-effect damage.

It's a weapon made for casters, crowd controllers, and anyone who wants their enemies to disappear in glowing bursts of destruction.

Stats at a GlanceWeapon Type: RangedAttack Type: ShotBase Damage: 25Amplification: 100% Spell DamageAttack Speed: 0.8Range: 15Special Effect:+2 Weapon Damage per level+2 Spell Damage per levelEvery attack explodes, dealing damage equal to 100% of your Spell Damage in a radius
Why Use Yggdrasill Staff?Explosive AoE Control
The real power of this staff is in its explosion radius. Every attack isn’t just a hit, it's a burst that punishes clustered enemies and clears entire groups in tight chambers.
Perfect for Mimir or Frigg Trails
The staff shines brightest when paired with Spell Damage-focused Trails, particularly:
Mimir’s Trail – For consistent spell scaling and Trail Pray synergyFrigg’s Trail – For high-variance Echo builds that make every cast unpredictableScales Extremely Well with Leveling
With +2 Weapon and +2 Spell Damage per level, this weapon becomes exponentially stronger the longer you survive, ideal for players planning deep runs or Hell difficulty clears.

Best Build PairingsHero: Mimir Follower – Increases Spell scaling and Trail Pray efficiencyGod’s Trail: Mimir or FriggAugments:Spell AmplificationTrail Pray conversionAoE Radius enhancementsOn-spell-kill triggers (XP gain, mana recovery, etc.)
Final Thoughts
The Yggdrasill Staff is more than a weapon; it's a commitment to magic, precision, and raw destruction. It rewards patient buildcrafting, Trail alignment, and mastery of spacing. Once it’s in your hands, you’re not just casting you’re commanding.

If your dream run involves wiping out waves in a single cast and watching glowing ruins scatter across the battlefield… this is your staff.

Have a build you love with Yggdrasill Staff? Share your setup in the community — we’re always watching for spellcasters who bend the game’s limits.

notes.title: Challengers of the Realms – Spotlight on Duriano’s Enemies
notes.content:
In every roguelite, the enemies are more than just targets, they shape how you play, how you build, and how far you make it. In Duriano, the enemy design is core to the entire experience. Whether you're breezing through early chambers or barely surviving in Hell difficulty, the variety and behavior of enemies make every run feel distinct.

This Character Spotlight takes a closer look at the unsung characters of the game: the enemies, their roles, mechanics, and how they evolve with your progress.

Enemy Variety: Designed to Disrupt
Every enemy in Duriano serves a purpose in the flow of combat. They're not random spawns, they're strategic tools designed to test specific parts of your build.

Here are a few key types:
Rushers & Dashers: These enemies close the gap quickly and punish passive or ranged builds. You’ll need mobility and awareness to survive their bursts.Ranged Attackers: They sit at the edges, adding pressure and chipping away at careless players. Positioning becomes critical when these are in the mix.Spawners & Multipliers: Some enemies bring reinforcements. If not dealt with quickly, a room can spiral into chaos fast.Tanky Units: Built to delay you, soak damage, and hold space. When combined with others, they turn ordinary rooms into endurance tests.
Each enemy type is crafted to counter different playstyles forcing you to adapt or fail.

Difficulty Scaling: Normal → Hard → Hell
As you push deeper, enemies don’t just hit harder they gain new mechanics that completely change how rooms play.
Normal DifficultyDesigned to teach you mechanics and build basics.Enemies have baseline stats and manageable groupings.Hard DifficultyEnemies gain +24% HP and damage, making fights more punishing.New enemy types begin to appear, adding more complexity to each encounter.Hell DifficultyThis is where things get intenseEnemies receive +48% to stats, and new enemies appear changing how entire rooms behave.
Chamber-Based Behavior
Enemy spawns also shift based on the room type:
Horde Chambers: High-density, rapid spawn rates. No rewards, just survival.Elite Chambers: Enemies are tougher but drop loot. High risk, high reward.Miniboss/Boss Chambers: Where enemy mechanics are at their most intense. These fights aren’t just harder, they're narrative, mechanical peaks in each run.
This dynamic room structure means enemies never feel repetitive. Each chamber type challenges a different part of your build and strategy.

Enemies with Intent
What makes Duriano's enemies special is that they're crafted with intent. They don’t exist just to block your progress, they exist to make your build matter. Every augment, Trail, stat, and weapon choice gets tested the second the room locks and the enemies swarm in.

And when you finally reach Hell mode? The game turns up the pressure, demanding mastery not just damage.

Keep running. Keep dodging. Keep adapting.
The enemies are watching and evolving.

notes.title: Unlockable Weapons in Duriano – Trade Fertilizer for Power
notes.content:
In Duriano, progression doesn’t just come from survival, it comes from choice. While your first runs introduce a few reliable weapons, many of the most unique tools in the game are locked behind one key resource: Fertilizer.

Earned through gameplay, Fertilizer is a special currency used to unlock new weapons, each offering advanced mechanics and scaling potential. These weapons aren't just stronger, they're built for players who understand the game’s deeper systems and want to explore new build archetypes.

Here’s a look at the current unlockable weapons and why they’re worth every drop of Fertilizer.

Yggdrasill Staff – Arcane Explosion Mastery
Unlock Cost: 250 Fertilizer
Weapon Type: Ranged
Scaling: 100% Spell Damage
Special Effect:
+2 Weapon Damage per level+2 Spell Damage per levelAttacks explode, dealing Spell AoE damage in a radius
This staff is a caster’s dream. Once unlocked, it becomes one of the best tools for Spell Damage scaling, especially with Trails like Mimir or Frigg. Ideal for AoE control and burst-focused builds, the Yggdrasill Staff turns every projectile into a spell detonation.

Rúnar’s Vex – The Living Thornfield
Unlock Cost: 250 Fertilizer
Weapon Type: Melee (Aura)
Scaling: Thorn
Special Effect:
+2 Weapon Damage per level+2 Thorn per levelConstant aura damage around the player
Unlike traditional melee weapons, Rúnar’s Vex doesn’t swing; it surrounds you with passive damage. Perfect for builds focused on HP, regeneration, or Thorn stacking, this weapon pairs beautifully with Trails like Eir or Forseti. Once unlocked, it opens up entire new playstyles for players who like to tank damage and deal it back without lifting a finger.

How to Get Fertilizer
Fertilizer is earned by completing runs, clearing chambers. The more you play, the more you’ll gain. It’s designed as a long-term progression resource, letting you unlock gear that matches your growing mastery of the game.

Pro tip: Focused builds, efficient clears, and deeper runs will earn Fertilizer faster.

Why These Weapons Are Locked
These aren’t beginner tools. Unlocking weapons through Fertilizer:
Encourages you to explore multiple build pathsGives a long-term goal beyond each individual runEnsures you’ve developed a feel for synergy before wielding advanced tools
Each unlocked weapon dramatically shifts the way you approach combat and progression rewarding knowledge, not just currency.

We want every unlock to feel like a new chapter in your build journey — and Fertilizer is the bridge that gets you there.

Spend wisely. Build boldly. And find the weapon that fits your fate.

notes.title: Dev Chat #2 – What’s Next for Duriano?
notes.content:
Welcome back to our Dev Chat series, where we pull back the curtain and share the direction, challenges, and ideas shaping Duriano. With thousands of runs played and a growing community behind us, it’s time to answer the big question:

What’s next for Duriano?

In this post, we’ll walk you through what we’re building behind the scenes — from upcoming features to major system expansions — and how your feedback is helping us shape the Nine Realms.

1. More Heroes, More Builds, More Chaos
The current roster of 7 durian heroes offers a lot of variety, but we know players want even more unique starting styles and strategies. We're working on new characters with radically different scaling mechanics — including one that leans into cooldown-based damage and another that thrives on low health.

Each new hero isn’t just a stat reshuffle — it’s a chance to open up a new archetype for builds. Expect new traits, stat tradeoffs, and entirely different ways to approach Trail synergy.

2. New God’s Trails Are Coming
Right now, players are finding smart ways to master the existing Trails — Forseti, Mimir, Frigg, Eir, Hoor, Hodr, and Vidar. But the pantheon isn’t complete.

We’re introducing at least two new God’s Trails in upcoming patches. These will come with their own:
Blessing biasesUnique Resonance effectsStrategic trade-offs

They’ll open the door for playstyles not currently supported — including status effects, summon mechanics, and more luck-manipulation builds.

3. More Weapon Types and Interactions
Weapon diversity is a huge part of Duriano’s gameplay loop. Right now, we have a solid foundation, but we’re expanding the arsenal with:
New weapon types (including support-based and charge-up weapons)New damage types and amplification mechanicsDeeper synergy between specific God Trails and certain weapons

This means more ways to tailor your run — and more reasons to revisit older heroes with new strategies.

4. Quality of Life & Feedback Features
We're also working on improvements based on your feedback:
Better UI clarity for Trail and stat stackingHero selection improvements and in-game stat summariesAdditional controller and keyboard hotkey optionsImproved death breakdown so you can review your run in detail

We want your victories to feel earned — and your defeats to teach you something.

5. Community Involvement Is Just Beginning
Our Early Access phase is built around player feedback. We’re listening on Steam, Discord, and social platforms to help guide:
Balance tuningTrail scaling adjustmentsAugment varietyVisual clarity in high-intensity fights

We’ve already implemented multiple fixes and balance changes directly from player bug reports — and that will continue. You’re not just playing Duriano. You’re helping build it.

Final Word: We're Just Getting Started
Duriano launched with a strong foundation — and what’s coming next is even bigger. New heroes, deeper builds, and expanded lore will take the game further into myth and madness. This is a game designed to grow run by run, patch by patch.

Thank you for being part of the journey. We can’t wait to show you what’s next.

notes.title: Master of Evasion – Norn Weaver Character Spotlight
notes.content:
Among the many unique heroes in Duriano, few embody mystery and control quite like the Norn Weaver. A spectral figure tied to fate itself, the Norn Weaver dances through danger not with brute force, but with sheer evasiveness and precision damage. If you’re the kind of player who thrives on agility, dodging death, and scaling power through speed and luck, this is the hero for you.

Who Is the Norn Weaver?
The Norn Weaver is a durian imbued with the soul of a spectral entity — a being that threads destiny itself. She represents fate not as something passive, but as a weapon. In Duriano, that manifests as extreme evasion, elegant agility, and glass-cannon potential with the right build.

Visually, she’s one of the most graceful and haunting heroes in the roster, wrapped in ethereal energy and otherworldly elegance. But don’t let the appearance fool you — she’s deadly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102131/480938ac97f5454c42d03bd2d7003df77a86cd13.png
Hero Stats+20 Evasion-50 ArmorShe starts with a high evasion bonus but sacrifices raw defense, meaning she avoids damage more than she absorbs it. This makes her ideal for high-skill players who love precision and mobility.

Special EffectEvasion is capped at 90+1 Extra Damage for every 3 EvasionNorn Weaver thrives on stacking evasion as both a defensive layer and a damage amplifier. Every blessing or augment that adds to evasion directly increases her attack output — creating a dynamic where defensive growth leads to offensive payoff.

But the cap at 90 means your optimization matters. There’s no infinite scaling here — only strategic, calculated growth.

Recommended PlaystylePrioritize blessings and augments that increase evasion or movement speed.Pair with weapons that strike frequently, like Elemental Spear or Bows, to maximize her bonus damage.Avoid armor-reliant trails like Forseti — instead, lean into Frigg, Hoor, or Mimir, which favor mobility, spell synergy, and high-risk play.Use her natural slipperiness to weave through dense enemy groups and bosses — every dodge is a survival win.
Why Choose Norn Weaver?
The Norn Weaver is a character built for players who enjoy finesse over force. She’s not about tanking hits — she’s about never getting hit in the first place. With the right decisions, she transforms into a fast-moving, high-damage assassin who turns evasiveness into pure offensive pressure.

She rewards careful builds and sharp reaction times. And when you start seeing enemies fall before they can even touch you, you’ll know fate is in your hands.

notes.title: Gods’ Trail Explained – Passive Skills & Resonance Levels
notes.content:
Inside the Gods’ Trail – Passive Ability System in Duriano
Power is earned through choice, not chance.

In Duriano, every run is shaped by the decisions you make — and nothing defines those decisions more than the Gods’ Trail system. At its core, this is more than just a skill tree. It’s a layered, passive ability system that grows with you, reflects your playstyle, and transforms every battle into a personalized divine trial.

This post breaks down what the Gods’ Trail is, how it works, and why it’s one of the most important systems in the game.

What Is the Gods’ Trail?
The Gods’ Trail is a passive progression path that players choose in the start of their run. Each trail represents a different Norse deity and grants unique thematic bonuses and scaling passive effects tied to specific stats or gameplay archetypes.

This system isn’t just about adding power — it’s about identity. Picking a God’s Trail is like choosing your role in the divine war.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102131/ebd6e8eec755b37178276d24797b59f8ea56cfd3.png

How It WorksAt the start of each run, you’ll choose one of the available Gods’ Trails.Each trail enhances certain blessing types (such as HP, Spell, Armor, or Speed).Progress through the trail by gaining through blessings, augments.As your Trail Pray increases, you unlock Resonance — passive boosts and a unique Resonance Skill.
Every trail has different scaling mechanics. Some reward aggressive kills, others reward survival, spell power, or randomness. Mastering how they scale is key to building a strong, synergistic run.

Trail Examples
Here are a few examples of the Trails and their gameplay focus:
Forseti’s Trail: Tank-focused. Grants bonuses to armor and shield generation. Resonance skills convert your defense into powerful map-wide bursts.Mimir’s Trail: Spell-scaling and mana synergy. Unlocks burst spell power and AoE damage that scales with your magical output.Frigg’s Trail: Chaos and randomness. You’ll get unpredictable buffs, coins, items, or stat bursts — and every resonance increases the number of random events triggered.
Every trail feels distinct and encourages different builds, weapons, and even different heroes.

Why It Matters
The Gods’ Trail system rewards consistency and strategic scaling. It lets you build long-term synergy across multiple rooms — and when paired with the right hero and blessings, it can define your entire playstyle.

Whether you want to deal damage through movement, gain power from shields, or rely on spell-critical builds, the trail you choose shapes your path.

The Road Ahead
We’re continuing to refine the Trails system based on your feedback — with more gods, new Resonance abilities, and additional interactions planned for future updates.

Whether you're embracing Mimir’s runic mastery or braving Vidar’s reckless onslaught, know that the gods are watching — and your trail is yours to carve.

notes.title: Bearer of Wisdom – Mimir Follower Enters the Fray
notes.content:
Hero Durian #3 – MIMIR FOLLOWER Spotlight
Master of knowledge, bearer of divine insight.

In this spotlight, we dive into one of the most intellectually powerful heroes in Duriano — the Mimir Follower, a durian touched by the soul of an ancient Norse sage. If you prefer clever builds, spell synergy, and deep scaling potential over brute force, this hero was made for you.

Who is Mimir Follower?
The Mimir Follower channels the essence of Mímir, the legendary wellspring of wisdom in Norse myth. In Duriano, that wisdom takes the form of precise spell power, superior Trail Pray synergy, and highly specialized build opportunities.

This isn’t a hero that smashes through the frontline. Instead, Mimir Follower manipulates stats, optimizes blessings, and amplifies spell effectiveness with surgical precision. Choosing this hero means choosing control, calculation, and high-risk spell builds that reward deep understanding of the game’s systems.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102131/d402dbb25474834aa985365e8b7ce76c48a59819.png
Hero Stats+30 Trail PrayThe Mimir Follower starts with a strong boost to Trail Pray, immediately improving your access to God’s Trail resonance and overall blessing efficiency.

Special Effect
Trail Pray modifications are increased by 100%Spell Damage modifications are increased by 50%Physical Damage, Thorn, and Armor modifications are reduced
Mimir Follower is all about maximizing magical output and Trail scaling. The tradeoff? You’re not meant to take hits or rely on brute stats. Physical builds will suffer, and defensive scaling is significantly reduced.

This specialization makes Mimir Follower ideal for players who want to lean into Frigg’s randomness, Mimir’s own rune mastery, or Eir’s recovery magic while avoiding more direct or tanky paths like Forseti or Vidar.

Recommended PlaystyleFocus on Trail Pray-heavy blessings to trigger synergy as early as possible.Choose weapons like the Yggdrasill Staff, which scales heavily with spell damage.Pair with God Trails like Mimir, Frigg, or Eir to make the most of magical stacking.Avoid physical or thorn-based augments — these are heavily penalized.
Why Choose Mimir Follower?
Mimir Follower isn’t for beginners — but in the right hands, this hero offers one of the most powerful spell-focused builds in the game. If you love numbers ticking up, runes aligning perfectly, and watching spells scale beyond reason, Mimir is your path.

For those who trust in knowledge more than brute strength, the Mimir Follower opens up a new dimension of strategy and control.

notes.title: Dev Chat #1 – Crafting a Norse Roguelite
notes.content:
Forged in Myth – Behind the World of Duriano
Welcome to the first entry in our Dev Chat series, where we take you behind the scenes of Duriano — our fast-paced, top-down roguelite with a mythological twist. In this installment, we're talking about the vision, challenges, and design choices behind building a roguelite game inspired by Norse mythology — and shaped around a very unexpected hero.

 
Why Norse Mythology?
We’ve always loved mythologies where gods aren't perfect — they're flawed, fierce, and far from untouchable. Norse mythology is rich with chaos, prophecy, betrayal, and rebirth — all themes that align naturally with roguelite design.

In Duriano, we didn’t want to simply borrow Norse gods as cameos. We wanted to build a world after the Divine Collapse — a catastrophic mythic event where realms shattered, gods fell, and only fragments of their power remain.

Now, in the ruins of that collapse, even something as strange as a cursed durian fruit can rise to challenge fate and reclaim divine power.

The gods you fight, the powers you inherit, the blessings you choose — everything is grounded in Norse symbols, trails, and fates. But it's filtered through our own chaotic, sometimes humorous, vision of what comes after the end of an age.

 
A Roguelite at its Core
At the heart of Duriano is replayability. No run is the same. Between chamber types, enemy patterns, divine blessings, and build paths, our goal was to create something that feels fresh every time you play — but never random just for the sake of it.

Each system in the game reinforces this philosophy:
God’s Trails act as skill paths that define your build with powerful “Resonance” abilitiesFate’s Flavors are the core modifiers that stack and evolve your combat styleAugments and Blessings offer micro-decisions with macro effects on your strategy
We wanted progression to matter — not just between runs, but during each run. You don’t just get stronger, you get smarter. You learn to adapt, pick your paths, and survive divine punishment one decision at a time.

 
The Tone: Dark, But Playful
Yes, you're battling gods. Yes, you're unlocking cursed weapons. Yes, there’s a mysterious Eternal Keeper pulling strings. But you’re still playing as a fruit.

We knew Duriano would work best if it balanced grim Norse lore with absurdity and charm. That balance has become a core part of the game’s identity:
A dark, intense world where damage numbers pop with styleMythic creatures reimagined with a twistCombat that’s deadly serious
This tone helps us lean into what makes roguelites memorable — not just their systems, but their moments.
 What’s Next
As we continue developing Duriano, we’re doubling down on what players are loving most:
More God’s Trails and unique resonance effectsNew heroes with drastically different stat buildsAdditional chamber types to challenge your decision-makingQuality-of-life improvements and progression systems that reward mastery
Early Access is just the beginning — and your feedback is a vital part of what’s coming next.

 
Talk to Us
If you’re enjoying Duriano, we want to hear from you. What builds are working? What runs are memorable? What systems feel unclear? The Dev Chat series will continue, and we’ll be sharing more insights on design, lore, balance, and what's evolving in the game.

Thanks for playing — and thank you for being part of this journey with us.

—
The Adisoft Team

notes.title: Duriano Weapons & Powers
notes.content:
Forged for Battle – Duriano’s Weapons and Their Hidden Powers
In Duriano, your weapon is more than just a tool – it’s a key to your strategy, your build, and ultimately your survival. Each weapon in the game brings its own strengths, playstyle, and unique powers that shape how you face the trials of Muspelheim and beyond. Whether you prefer brute force, swift precision, magical destruction, or thorny endurance – there’s a weapon for every warrior.

Let’s take a closer look at the armory of Duriano and uncover what makes each one special:

War Hammer – Power Unleashed
A devastating melee weapon made for those who live for raw damage.
Weapon Type : MeleeAttack Type : SweepBase Damage : 40Damage Amplification : 100% Physical DamageThe War Hammer scales with your level, gaining:
+3 Weapon Damage per player level+1 Physical Damage per player levelIt’s slow but brutal, sweeping enemies aside with overwhelming force. Pair it with high armor or shield builds for a near-unstoppable juggernaut.

Elemental Spear – Balance of Force and Magic
This versatile thrusting weapon blends both physical and spell damage:
Weapon Type: MeleeAttack Type: ThrustBase Damage: 15Damage Amplification: 50% Physical Damage 50% Spell DamageThe Elemental Spear scales with your level, gaining:
+3 Weapon Damage per level+1 Physical & Spell Damage per levelIdeal for hybrid builds, the Elemental Spear is quick and precise, capable of piercing defenses with elemental energy and physical might alike.

Bows and Arrows – Rain of Death
Prefer to keep your enemies at a distance? This ranged weapon excels at multi-target damage:
Weapon Type: RangeAttack Type: ShotBase Damage: 12Amplification: 75% Physical DamageThe Bows and Arrows scales with your level, gaining:
+3 Weapon Damage per level+2 Split Shot +1 per 2/4/6/7 AugmentsWith high attack speed and critical potential, it turns the battlefield into a shooting gallery. Great for players who want high mobility and wide coverage.

Yggdrasill Staff – Magic That Burns Bright
Harness the explosive force of ancient magic. Every shot from this ranged staff detonates with Spell Damage:
Weapon Type: RangeAttack Type: ShotBase Damage: 25Amplification: 100% Spell DamageThe Yggdrasill Staff scales with your level, gaining:
+2 Weapon Damage per level+2 Spell Damage per levelEach attack explodes in a radiusPerfect for spellcasters, this staff rewards high spell builds with massive AoE and reliable burst potential.

Rúnar’s Vex – Thorns and TenacityThis unique aura-based melee weapon damages foes that dare get close:
Weapon Type: MeleeAttack Type: AuraBase Damage: 15Amplification: 50% ThornThe Rúnar’s Vex scales with your level, gaining:
+2 Weapon Damage per level+2 Thorn per levelThough it lacks crits or range, Rúnar’s Vex is ideal for tanky, defensive builds where enemies take damage simply for being near you.

Choose Your Weapon, Choose Your Fate
Every weapon in Duriano isn’t just a stat stick – it’s a core part of your playstyle. As your character grows, your weapon scales with you, offering new opportunities and strategies in synergy with God’s Trails, Fates, and Augments. Whether you’re a melee brawler, a spell-slinging sorcerer, or a slippery ranged attacker, mastering your weapon is key to mastering the game.

So the question remains:
Which weapon will you wield in the Trials of the Gods?

notes.title: Hero Spotlight #2 – Valkyrian Reveal
notes.content:
Meet Valkyrian, the Valkyrie Durian
Swift. Fearless. Divine.

In this second entry of our Duriano Hero Spotlight series, we’re excited to reveal a high-speed warrior forged in the image of battle’s most elegant force: the Valkyrian — a durian hero born from the soul of a Norse Valkyrie.

Who is Valkyrian?
Valkyrian is no ordinary fruit. Infused with the essence of a celestial shieldmaiden, this hero channels the spirit of swift combat and relentless forward momentum. With her unmatched agility and combat flow, Valkyrian is designed for players who love to move fast, strike faster, and never stop dodging.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102131/2dac400e857b9f211e8bc7d0238ee4d8af6fc91d.png
Whether you're dashing through a swarm of enemies or unloading rapid attacks before disappearing into the next wave, Valkyrian makes every movement feel like an art form.
Hero Stats+20% Attack Speed+1 Dash ChargeDash Range 5Dash DurationPick Up Range 5These stats form the foundation of her playstyle: fast-paced, combo-friendly, and relentlessly mobile.

Special Effect
Max HP modifications are decreased by 50%

This means Valkyrian trades durability for deadly speed. Her reduced health scaling encourages a high-risk, high-reward playstyle — ideal for skilled players who can stay on the move and outmaneuver enemies instead of relying on raw defense.

How to Play Valkyrian[previewyoutube=k78UGKU2uqI;full][/previewyoutube]
Valkyrian shines when paired with weapons that benefit from fast attack rates, like the Bows and Arrows or Elemental Spear, and God Trails that reward speed or crit-based builds — such as Hoor’s Trail. The bonus dash charge also gives her strong synergy with mobility-focused blessings and trail effects.

Pro Tips:
Use the extra dash charge to weave between enemies and reposition aggressively.Stack attack speed upgrades to push Valkyrian’s DPS to insane levels.Be cautious with damage intake — you’re powerful, but fragile.
Why Choose Valkyrian?
If you’re the type of player who values agility, finesse, and fast-paced execution over brute force, Valkyrian is your hero. She rewards precise movement, perfect positioning, and calculated aggression.

She’s not about standing your ground. She’s about owning the battlefield — one dash at a time.

notes.title: Duriano Early Access Deep Dive
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102131/76b025cb478606a7f40d8f40500f101f17a1f1a6.pngDuriano Combat System + Roguelite Progression Explained
Hey warriors of the Nine Realms,

As we continue our journey through the Duriano development, it’s time to give you a first look into two of Duriano’s most exciting systems — our fast-paced combat mechanics and Roguelite progression loop that’ll keep you coming back for just one more run.

Combat in Duriano: Simple to Learn, Satisfying to Master
At its core, Duriano is a top-down action rogue-lite, where every swing, slash, and dash counts. The combat is designed to feel fluid, reactive, and impactful — whether you’re clearing waves of enemies or dodging deadly boss attacks.
Core Combat Features:Auto-fire: Your duriano hero auto-attacks enemies in range.Dash to Survive: Every hero has a quick dash to evade enemy attacks, reposition in battle, or break through swarms.Weapon Variety: Choose from 5 mythical weapons, each with unique effects — from flame-blades to lightning-infused hammers.God’s Trail Abilities: Unlock active powers based on the Norse god path you follow. Build a strategy that fits your playstyle and dominate the battlefield.Wave-Based Encounters: Every chamber throws something new at you — enemies with unique mechanics, mini-bosses.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102131/13cbd0750add4559f579aafe5eef10e914b031a8.png

Whether you're slicing through a horde in Helheim or facing a boss in Asgard, our goal is to deliver combat that feels tight, satisfying, and chaotic in the best way possible.

Roguelite Progression: Grow Stronger with Every Run
Death isn’t the end in Duriano. It’s a stepping stone.

As a true rogue-lite, every run helps you progress — even if you fall in battle. Through our permanent upgrade system, every defeat makes you stronger, every loop opens new doors, and every choice matters.
Progression Highlights:Fertilizer Currency: Earned through gameplay and used at the hub in Helheim to purchase permanent upgrades.Unlock New Heroes: Start with a core durian hero and unlock 7 total variants, each with unique strengths and styles.Expand Your Arsenal: Discover and upgrade new weapons, Fate’s Favors, and God Trails.Build Diversity: No two runs are alike. Mix and match blessings, skills, and gear to create wild synergies.Progress the Story: Defeating bosses reveals more of the prophecy of Ragnarok.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102131/de2d4cacf6fa91120a6f7fa46d230a5b4bbc4100.jpg

We’ve built the game around a “fail forward” philosophy — rewarding you with new options and power no matter how far you make it.

Are You Ready to Fight, Fall, and Rise Again?
Whether you're a fan of tight action gameplay or the thrill of unpredictable roguelite runs, Duriano is built to challenge and reward you. Each loop is a step closer to uncovering your destiny — and maybe, just maybe, saving the Nine Realms from Ragnarok.

Let us know in the comments: What’s your favorite part of roguelites? What kind of combat build are you excited to try?

The loop begins soon. Stay sharp. Stay divine.

Normal Mode (11 floors): A balanced entry point with bonus items like Mimir’s Lost Chapter (+EXP and coin gains) and Loki’s Bargain Token (shop discounts).Hard Mode (18 floors): Enemies are stronger, with 24% increased damage and HP. Expect new threats and tougher waves.Hell Mode (18 floors): Welcome to chaos. Random Aura Enemies are added to each wave with powerful buffs like:Attack Aura: Boosts damage of all enemies nearbyDefense Aura: Greatly reduces incoming damageHeal Aura: Restores HP to enemies over timeSpeed Aura: Increases movement speed
Hell Mode also features a massive +48% boost to both enemy HP and damage.
Why Play in Early Access?
This is more than just early gameplay — it’s a chance to become part of Duriano’s journey. Here’s what you get:
Exclusive access to the foundational systems of the gameDeep build variety with hero variants, God Trails, Fate’s Favors, and 5 mythical weaponsChance to give feedback that directly impacts balance, content, and featuresSignificant discount during early access (50% OFF!)What’s Next?
While early access already includes plenty of action and variety, we’re not done yet. Here's what we're working on:
More playable heroes and enemy typesAdditional Fate’s Favors and divine abilitiesNew maps and realmsExpanded story and interactionsCommunity-driven improvements to balance and pacingJoin the Fight Today
Duriano is live on Steam — download now, choose your path, and carve your legacy into the Nine Realms. Early warriors are shaping the future of this rogue-lite, one run at a time.

Let the gods tremble — the durians have arrived.

notes.title: About the Game
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102131/1ab849fd76bf4f442f8dc5b5a46c398f097c9108.png
Get ready for an epic and delightfully quirky adventure in "Duriano," a 3D top-down action roguelite that plunges you into the heart of Norse mythology with a twist! Imagine stepping into the shoes of a heroic durian, armed to the teeth and ready to take on the gods of Asgard. Yes, you read that right – a durian!

What is Duriano?
"Duriano" is an exhilarating game where you play as a variety of durian heroes, each embodying the essence of a Norse god or mythical creature. Your mission? To wield powerful weapons and divine abilities to vanquish the gods of Asgard. It’s a unique blend of fast-paced action and strategic gameplay.

Key Features That Make Duriano Stand Out:

 Durian Hero Variants: Choose from a diverse cast of durian heroes, each with unique abilities and playstyles. Will you be the swift and agile Loki-durian, or the mighty Thor-durian, smashing foes with thunderous force?

 Fate's Favors & God Paths: Enhance your hero with divine gifts known as Fate's Favors, providing buffs and unique powers. Select from specific God Trails tied to Norse gods, unlocking unique combat skills and abilities that tailor your playstyle.

 Mythic Weapons: Discover and wield an array of mythical weapons, each with distinct attributes and effects. Fuse these weapons with your hero's abilities and Fate's Favors to create powerful combinations and dominate your enemies.

 Synergistic Combos: Experiment with combining different hero variants, Fate's Favors, and weapons to discover synergistic combos. Mastering these combinations is key to overcoming challenging enemies, hordes, and formidable bosses.

 Adaptive Strategy: Experience dynamic roguelite gameplay where each run presents new environments, enemies, and challenges. Make strategic decisions on-the-fly, adapting your build to the ever-changing threats and opportunities.

 Progression and Customization: Unlock new durian variants, Fate's Favors, and weapons as you progress, expanding your arsenal and strategic options. Invest in permanent upgrades, refining your divine arsenal and enhancing your hero's capabilities for future runs. 

Prepare for Battle!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102131/f36c58fbea23d50fa1a86e0698deb8c61fea477f.png
Dive into the mystical realms of Norse mythology and prepare for an epic journey filled with action, strategy, and endless replayability. Harness the power of the gods, create devastating combos, and lead your durian hero to victory against the gods of Asgard.
